worldcombat.skill.octazooka.summary: Spray several bursts of ink in the target's face; each burst deals damage and about half the time the ink blinds it and cuts its accuracy.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.use.0: A chained ink stream at close-to-mid range
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.use.1: Blind the target and cut its accuracy
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.use.2: Leave an ink stain on the ground
Each bolt deals %1$s special damage and %2$s bolts are sprayed; the whole cast has a %3$s chance to drop accuracy by %4$s stages.
Bolts fly at %1$s up to %2$s blocks, spaced %3$s apart with a %4$s degree spread.
The stream steers up to %1$s degrees per tick toward the target; each bolt throws about %2$s ink drops and an ink stain stays about %3$s. Thick ink is currently %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.preference.t: On: per-bolt power ×1.5, +10% blind chance and ×1.3 stain duration, but one fewer bolt, +2 ticks between bolts, +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: more, lighter bolts sprayed faster.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values open with ink from further away.
On: it may leave a hold position to find a firing line. Off: it only sprays when already in range.
